reason: I use AI all day at work, but I'm not letting it invest or pay for things with my actual money, and a cartoon pet running my portfolio makes it feel like a toy. My robo-adviser already rebalances for me and it's boring, which is exactly what I want.
objection: An AI agent that can move my money on its own, with no broker named yet and no price, presented as a Tamagotchi. Limits and a kill switch don't fix the basic issue that I don't want an AI making money decisions for me.
would_change_my_mind: A big, known, regulated broker holding the account and standing behind it, plus a year or two of real-money results from people I trust, with the pet as an option I can turn off.
